ja294:1.1: Who is this with a lovely, rich, supremely melodious sound,
ja294:1.3: Who chirps unbroken like a young peacock on the Jambu tree’s branch?
ja294:2.1: A son of good family knows how to praise a good family,
ja294:2.3: My friend, similar to a young tiger, I give to you, please eat.
ja294:3.1: I see after a long time those who speak falsely come together,
ja294:3.4: and those who praise one another.
